# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.18 — Architecture hardening and scalable projection

<!-- update-summary: Preview.18 closes the architecture audit with transactional retention and settings ownership, reparse-safe file boundaries, durable payload cleanup, resumable verified updates, bounded Internet Share admission, and scalable keyset/FTS search. -->

Preview.18 is the architecture-hardening release built from the Preview.17 baseline. It keeps the Windows 10 1809/Windows 11 x64 product boundary, Dynamic Island experience, local-first storage, external-file safety rule, and Stable channel behavior while addressing the audit findings before further feature work.

- Retention candidate selection and destructive commit now share the database write authority and re-check pinned/source state at delete time. Bulk-removal counts report actual affected rows instead of stale candidate counts.
- App-owned payload deletion failures are recorded in a durable deferred-cleanup journal and retried without ever following or deleting external source-file references.
- DropLink receive finalization and ZIP input opening use reparse-aware confinement. Multi-file finalization rolls back committed outputs when possible and preserves unrecoverable residuals in failure state instead of hiding them.
- Settings application is owned by `SettingsApplicationCoordinator`, including startup, hotkey, Clipboard, Device Handoff, cross-device Clipboard, persistence, rollback and reconciliation. `MainViewModel` no longer owns that cross-service transaction.
- Item projection is owned by `ItemProjectionService`. The fixed visible projection was replaced with 200-item keyset continuation, incremental UI loading, and SQLite FTS5 trigram search. Schema v4 migration builds and maintains the search index while short queries retain the safe LIKE fallback.
- Update downloads can resume a validated `.download` prefix with HTTP Range support and still require the final complete SHA-256 before commit. Authenticode verification performs whole-chain revocation checking; Stable publication remains signing-gated.
- Crash markers use the same redaction boundary as normal diagnostics. Bounded logging exposes dropped-message telemetry, and network-service shutdown has a finite graceful drain budget.
- The encrypted Internet Share Worker now reads JSON with a real byte-bounded stream and uses mandatory Durable Object admission limiting for global/source creation pressure. Missing admission infrastructure fails closed.
- GitHub Actions dependencies are pinned to immutable commit SHAs. Pushes to `main` validate but do not publish; GitHub Release publication is an explicit `workflow_dispatch` action from `main`, and Stable publication fails closed without signing configuration.

## Validation boundary

Publication requires Core, Infrastructure and App tests; WinUI Release build; portable, MSIX, identity and Inno packaging; installer `/UPDATE`/restart/upgrade/uninstall lifecycle; en-US and zh-CN executable smoke; Worker tests; and website build/browser-route validation. Preview publication may remain unsigned, while Stable publication is signing-gated.

Hosted Windows evidence still does not substitute for physical Windows 10 1809/Windows 11 mixed-DPI and multi-monitor behavior, real Explorer/third-party OLE providers, accessibility review, two-device DropLink/Nearby Share, or an operator-deployed Internet Share Worker/browser acceptance matrix. Those rows remain **CONDITIONAL** rather than being inferred from CI.

## 中文说明

Preview.18 是对 Preview.17 之后整轮底层架构审计的集中修复版，而不是覆盖 Preview.17。它修复 Retention 与 Pin 的并发删除窗口、真实删除计数、DB 与 payload 清理一致性、DropLink/Junction 与 ZIP reparse 边界、设置半回滚状态分裂、崩溃日志脱敏、更新证书撤销检查、断点续传、Worker 请求体和创建准入等问题。

列表与搜索也不再依赖固定 500 条投影和深 OFFSET：主界面采用 200 条 keyset 增量加载，SQLite 升级到 schema v4 并维护 FTS5 trigram 搜索索引。Settings 多服务事务与列表查询编排分别从 `MainViewModel` 抽离到独立协调器，降低后续修改半径。

Preview.18 仍保留真机 OS/DPI/OLE/无障碍、双设备网络和实际 Worker 部署验收边界；托管 CI 通过不等价于这些人工/物理环境项目已完成。Preview 可以未签名，Stable 发布则必须满足签名门禁。
